doc_friction.issue: Named run.py like every experiment; importing it from a sibling experiment with `import run` collides with the importer's own module name, so milestone 2a loads it by importlib spec under a distinct name.

Returns after ~100 s with 'still running? call again' even under a longer outer timeout; I misread progress as 10-minute intervals and first wrote a 75-minute sweep time into the README (the 147-run sweep took ~17 min). Corrected before merge.

deviations.why: Milestone 2 in the proposal is the dense Sobol benchmark; the milestone 1 outcome changed the plan to put cycle count on the fidelity axis first, so this run tested that axis on the 49 logged designs (milestone 2a) before paying for the dense benchmark.
deviations.did: Ran the grid on the existing 49 designs with pre-registered H4-H6.
deviations.result: H4 and H6 supported, H5 equal cost; the dense benchmark now knows to cache per-cycle DFN.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
